criteria.reason: Simple words, rulebook and school-vote metaphors fit a 10-year-old; final paragraph is slightly saccharine but accessible.
Omits 100,000 signatures and 18-month deadline; falsely states only parliament can change the constitution, contradicting mandatory referendums.
Numbered steps and vivid analogies keep the explanation short and engaging.

factual_errors: Claims only parliament can change the constitution; Swiss constitutional amendments always require approval by the people in a mandatory vote
Voting age framed as varying 'depending on the topic'; it varies by level of government, not topic
summary: Child-appropriate language and engaging structure, but omits the 100,000-signature and 18-month facts and contains errors about who can change the constitution and voting age.
